summary_zh:
前來金圈，建議先去「辛格維爾國家公園」，再到「間歇泉」，用完餐後，再來最後再到黃金瀑布，這樣比較順路。 建議可以下午來，比較能看得到黃金般瀑布的色彩。

他有上、下兩個停車場，兩個都可以到，建議先到上方的停車場，這裡有旅客中心，再步行到下方瀑布觀景台。

旁邊的旅客服務中心，有餐廳、免費廁所，紀念品店，建議保留 2HR 在這裡，如果只是 90 分鐘的話，其實我覺得蠻趕的。
summary_en: Visit the Golden Circle first by going to Þingvellir National Park, then the Geysir area, have a meal, and finally head to Gullfoss; this route is the most efficient. It’s best to visit in the afternoon to see the waterfall’s golden hues. There are two parking lots—use the upper lot, which has a visitor center, then walk down to the lower viewing platform. The nearby visitor center offers a restaurant, free restrooms, and a souvenir shop; plan to spend about 2 hours there, as 90 minutes may feel rushed.
